name: jewel-os
description: Jewel OS - FMB's sealed executive-assistant agent runtime and command centre.

scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:ui
scripts.format: prettier --write src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/components src/visual src/lib index.html vite.config.ts

comment:dependencies: The sealed runtime (src/core, src/adapters, src/tools, src/runtime, jewel.mjs) has ZERO dependencies by design - nothing in the supply chain can alter Jewel's capability. Everything below belongs to the command-centre UI, which lives OUTSIDE the seal boundary and can only reach the runtime through the authenticated local API. It cannot grant itself a capability.
